The zebra pattern on the scarf has slight 'smearing' or blending where the fabric folds, lacking the crisp edge definition expected of a woven textile.
The fingers gripping the bottom left corner of the menu appear slightly fused together, and the thumb's position relative to the index finger lacks clear anatomical separation.
